OTTO_COLLEAGUE_BENEFACTOR.title: Colleagues Are Benefactors
OTTO_COLLEAGUE_BENEFACTOR.description:
Summon a random companion who is not imprisoned, replacing your current companion.
It immediately acts {Repeat:diff()} times.
With Zoo Bond, companions can coexist.
OTTO_STRIKE.title: Strike
OTTO_DEFEND.title: Defend
OTTO_CALL_FRIENDS.title: Call Friends
OTTO_CALL_FRIENDS.description:
Summon a random free companion, replacing the current one.
Zoo Bond allows different companions to coexist.
OTTO_RUSH.title: Rush! Rush! Rush!
OTTO_RUSH.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each active Zoo companion.
OTTO_WHEELCHAIR.title: Wheelchair
OTTO_CHIVE_POCKET.title: Chive Pocket
OTTO_THREE_WOLVES.title: B Three Wolves
OTTO_THREE_WOLVES.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
OTTO_KING_JIJI.title: King Jiji
OTTO_KING_JIJI.description:
If no companion is present, summon a random free companion.
All companions act once, then gain {Ancient:diff()} Ancient Meter per companion that acted.
OTTO_BLUE_CANDY.title: Blue Candy
OTTO_BLUE_CANDY.description:
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} Poison to ALL creatures.
If Xuan Dog is present, sacrifice it to prevent this Poison application to you.
OTTO_ICE.title: WOC! Ice!
OTTO_ICE.description:
At the start of your turn, gain {Amount:diff()} Block.
If Shan Ni Ruo is present, heal that much HP.
OTTO_MISSED_Q.title: How Did Q Miss?
OTTO_MISSED_Q.description:
An enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} Strength this turn.
If Huo Xing Bao is present, apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak and {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable.
OTTO_PRO_PLAYER.title: I Think I Am a Pro
OTTO_PRO_PLAYER.description:
Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Pix.
At the end of combat, convert each Pix into 1 Max HP.
OTTO_WAWO.title: Wawo!
OTTO_WAWO.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. They gain Retain this combat, but cannot be played this turn.
OTTO_ONE_HAND.title: One Hand
OTTO_ONE_HAND.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} Block.
If you played Amino Hand this turn, double the base Block.
OTTO_AMINO_HAND.title: Amino Hand
OTTO_AMINO_HAND.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
If you played One Hand this turn, double the base damage.
OTTO_SUONA.title: Suona, Doot Doot
OTTO_SUONA.description:
Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
You cannot play Attacks during your next turn.
OTTO_BULL_DEMON.title: Bull Demon
OTTO_BULL_DEMON.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Each Can played this combat reduces the cost of all Bull Demons by 1. Playing any Bull Demon resets this count.
OTTO_BACK_ELEPHANT.title: Back-Stomping Elephant
OTTO_SILVER.title: Terminal Silver
OTTO_SILVER.description:
You cannot play any more cards this turn.
Gain 3 additional Energy next turn.
OTTO_VOID_SNORLAX.title: Void Snorlax
OTTO_VOID_SNORLAX.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Until your next turn starts, reduce each instance of damage taken by {Reduction:diff()}.
OTTO_SPONGE_EKKO.title: Sponge Ekko
OTTO_SPONGE_EKKO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next Can you play this combat costs 0 Energy.
OTTO_VTUBER_ESSAY.title: Vtuber Essay
OTTO_VTUBER_ESSAY.description: Draw 8 cards. Discard the drawn cards that are not Cans.
OTTO_HALILU_TORNADO.title: Halilu Tornado
OTTO_HALILU_TORNADO.description: Add X random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}Attacks from all character pools to your Hand. They cost 0 this turn.
OTTO_NONEXISTENT.title: What Does Not Exist
OTTO_NONEXISTENT.description: Trigger your Gun Mu or Lao Gun and Gun Mu {Repeat:diff()} times, gaining 1 or 2 Intangible per trigger respectively.
OTTO_ZOO_BOND_CARD.title: Zoo Bond
OTTO_ZOO_BOND_CARD.description:
Summon all free companions.
Different companions can coexist this combat, one of each kind.
OTTO_SECOND_STREAM_GOAT.title: Second-Stream GOAT
OTTO_SECOND_STREAM_GOAT.description:
Summon and train Xuan Dog.
For this combat, its end-of-turn effect deals 10 damage and grants 10 Block.
OTTO_COMEBACK_DIRECTOR.title: Comeback Director
OTTO_COMEBACK_DIRECTOR.description:
Summon and train Huo Xing Bao.
For this combat, its end-of-turn effect grants 3 Strength and 3 Dexterity.
OTTO_ETERNAL_GOD.title: Eternal God
OTTO_ETERNAL_GOD.description:
Summon and train Shan Ni Ruo.
For this combat, its end-of-turn effect heals 4 HP and applies 4 Poison to all enemies.
OTTO_JOHNNIE_WALKER.title: Johnnie Walker
OTTO_JOHNNIE_WALKER.description: For this combat, all cards currently in your Hand gain Can.
OTTO_THEIR_OWN_WAY.title: Their Own Way
OTTO_THEIR_OWN_WAY.description: Copy one enemy's next Attack, Block and transferable buffs, using your own stats. Attacks hit that enemy; Block and buffs go to you. Ignore unconvertible buffs accompanying attacks. Other intents cannot be selected.
OTTO_REASON.title: Spoken Reason
OTTO_REASON_GUARD.title: Spoken Guard
OTTO_CHOP_AGAIN.title: Chop Again
OTTO_AUG.title: AUG
OTTO_AUG.description:
Exhaust another card.
Xuan Gou gains {Boost:diff()} damage and Block this combat (stackable).
OTTO_HEADER.title: Perfect Header
OTTO_HEADER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shan Ni Ruo gains {Boost:diff()} healing this combat (stackable).
OTTO_MA_MAI_PI.title: Ma Mai Pi
OTTO_MA_MAI_PI.description:
Apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable.
Huo Xing Bao grants 1 more Strength and Dexterity this combat (stackable).
OTTO_FLIP_CLOUDS.title: Flip the Clouds
OTTO_FLIP_CLOUDS.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Discard 1 of those cards, then auto-play the rest in order for free with random valid targets. Unplayable cards move to their normal result pile.
OTTO_TENG_YANG.title: Teng Yang World
OTTO_TENG_YANG.description: Requires Shan Ni Ruo. He blocks every hit of the next enemy attack that targets you, then goes to prison.
OTTO_DEEP_SEA_FISH.title: Deep Sea Fish
OTTO_DEEP_SEA_FISH.description: Requires Huo Xing Bao. Send him to prison. Gain 5 Strength and 5 Dexterity.
OTTO_WHY.title: Why, Oh Why
OTTO_WHY.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards each turn. Randomize all existing combat cards to cost 0–3 for this combat; reroll each time drawn. X-cost and unplayable cards are unchanged. Hide enemy intents.
OTTO_HUMILIATE.title: Humiliate the Weak
OTTO_HUMILIATE.description: Kill an enemy with less current HP than you. Does not bypass special death prevention.
OTTO_HANDSOME.title: Handsome, OTTO!
OTTO_HANDSOME.description: An enemy loses {Strength:diff()} Strength. Gain {Strength:diff()} Strength.
OTTO_HA_BI_XIA.title: Ha Bi Xia
OTTO_HA_BI_XIA.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain Ancient charge equal to their total actual HP lost.
OTTO_YOUR_YOUTH.title: Your Youth, Revived
OTTO_YOUR_YOUTH.description: Release all of your imprisoned companions and summon them together.
OTTO_RED_BOOTS.title: Kneeling Red Boots
OTTO_RED_BOOTS.description: Requires Xuan Dog. Send him to prison. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain Block equal to their total actual HP lost.
OTTO_ANCIENT_HAM.title: Ancient Ham
OTTO_ADVANCING_KING.title: The Advancing King
OTTO_ADVANCING_KING.description: Stun an enemy for its next action. Gain {Ancient:diff()} Ancient charge.
OTTO_NAMED_HOU.title: Named Hou Guoyu
OTTO_NAMED_HOU.description: Lose at most 10 HP in total between the starts of your turns. Does not prevent direct kills.
OTTO_BRO_SORRY.title: Sorry, Bro
OTTO_BRO_MOVE.title: Move, Bro
OTTO_OU_XI_GEI.title: Ou Xi Gei
OTTO_OU_XI_GEI.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
In Ancient Form, hit the same enemy one additional time.
OTTO_AI_YA_MI_NO.title: Ai Ya Mi No
OTTO_AI_YA_MI_NO.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Return 1 Ancient card from your discard pile to your hand.
OTTO_PIG_GO.title: Pig, Go
OTTO_PIG_GO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If Shan Ni Ruo is present, activate its current end-of-turn effect once.
OTTO_HOW_MUCH_LONGER.title: How Much Longer
OTTO_HOW_MUCH_LONGER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Whenever this card is retained, reduce its cost by 1, to a minimum of 0. Playing it clears only its own retain discount.
OTTO_ANON.title: Chihaya Anon-official
OTTO_ANON.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
You may move 1 card in your hand to the leftmost position.
OTTO_SAKIKO.title: Toyokawa Sakiko-official
OTTO_SAKIKO.description: Each turn, gain 1 Energy the first time you manually play a Can card (from any hand position).
OTTO_UIKA.title: Misumi Uika-official
OTTO_UIKA.description:
Choose a non-X-cost Can Attack in your hand. Add a copy to the rightmost position.
It costs 0 this turn and gains Exhaust.
OTTO_KARASU.title: _Karasu_
OTTO_KARASU.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Put up to 2 random Can cards from your draw pile into your hand.
OTTO_PHANTOM_HAZE.title: Phantom Haze
OTTO_PHANTOM_HAZE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you triggered Can at least {Threshold:diff()} times earlier this turn, gain 1 Intangible.
OTTO_RANA.title: Kaname Rana-official
OTTO_RANA.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Repeat once per Can trigger earlier this turn.
OTTO_AI_YA_MI_NO.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose 1 Ancient card to put into your hand.
OTTO_ANON.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose up to 1 card to move to the leftmost position.
OTTO_UIKA.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a non-X-cost Can Attack to copy.
OTTO_MO_MO_MI_NO.title: Mo Mo Mi No
OTTO_MO_MO_MI_NO.description: Outside Ancient Form, gain {Block:diff()} Block and {Ancient:diff()} Ancient Meter. Otherwise, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
OTTO_AO_LI_AN_FEI.title: Ao Li An Fei
OTTO_AO_LI_AN_FEI.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Outside Ancient Form, gain {Ancient:diff()} Ancient Meter. In Ancient Form, apply 2 Vulnerable before attacking instead.
OTTO_GONG_GONG.title: Gong Gong Again
OTTO_GONG_GONG.description: Summon Xuan Gou and have it act on the target {Repeat:diff()} times. Each kill adds 1 action; choose a random new enemy when the target dies. Unplayable while Xuan Gou is imprisoned.
OTTO_LAW_ABIDING.title: Law Abiding Streamer
OTTO_LAW_ABIDING.description:
Summon Shan Ni Ruo.
The first time it would be imprisoned this combat, it acts 3 times instead.
OTTO_KFC.title: KFC
OTTO_KFC.description:
Requires Shan Ni Ruo.
Until your next turn, its healing deals {Multiplier:diff()} times its normal healing to all enemies instead. It acts once immediately.
OTTO_BIG_BLADE.title: Fear Her Great Blade
OTTO_BIG_BLADE.description: Summon Xuan Dog. Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Until your next turn, while it is present, each enemy attack hit fully blocked by spending Block triggers a counter for 3 times its damage.
OTTO_WAVE_CRASH.title: Wave Crashes the Tower
OTTO_WAVE_CRASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. While Huo Xing Bao is present, repeat once for each point of positive Dexterity.
OTTO_I_AM_CHINESE.title: I am Chinese
OTTO_I_AM_CHINESE.description: Summon Huo Xing Bao and choose Strength or Dexterity Mode: actions grant only that stat, doubled.{IfUpgraded:show: Then it acts once.|}
OTTO_MARS_STRENGTH_CHOICE.title: Strength Mode
OTTO_MARS_STRENGTH_CHOICE.description: Huo Xing Bao grants twice its normal Strength and no Dexterity.
OTTO_MARS_DEXTERITY_CHOICE.title: Dexterity Mode
OTTO_MARS_DEXTERITY_CHOICE.description: Huo Xing Bao grants twice its normal Dexterity and no Strength.
OTTO_KOREAN_HAND.title: Korean Hand
OTTO_KOREAN_HAND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this kills the target, gain 50 Ancient Meter and return this card to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
OTTO_OLD_REASON.title: Old Reason
OTTO_OLD_REASON.description: Outside Ancient Form, double your current Ancient Meter. Otherwise, gain 3 Energy and draw 3 cards.
OTTO_GIRL_BAND_FAN.title: Girl Band Fan
OTTO_GIRL_BAND_FAN.description: Add one card for each of the six Girl Band members to your hand{IfUpgraded:show: and Upgrade them|}. They cost 0 this turn.
OTTO_ALL_IN.title: all in! all in!
OTTO_ALL_IN.description: Automatically play all Ancient Form cards in your draw pile in order for free, choosing random targets. Excludes all copies of this card.
OTTO_AMINOS.title: Aminos
OTTO_AMINOS.description: Ancient Form lasts 1 extra round this combat. Also extend the current form by 1 round.
OTTO_LAUGHTER_CARD.title: OTTO Laughter
OTTO_LAUGHTER_CARD.description: When you trigger Can, play that card one additional time for free.
OTTO_SUONA_POWER_CARD.title: Suona
OTTO_SUONA_POWER_CARD.description: Each turn, play your third manually played card one additional time.
OTTO_LAST_XUAN_CARD.title: Last Xuan, Endless Youth
OTTO_LAST_XUAN_CARD.description: Summon Xuan Dog. On lethal damage while it is present, imprison it and restore HP to 50% of Max HP, rounded up. Can trigger again after rescuing it. Does not prevent direct kills.
OTTO_ATOMIC_BOMB.title: Atomic Bomb
OTTO_ATOMIC_BOMB.description:
Requires Shan Ni Ruo.
Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times its normal healing to all enemies, then imprison it.
OTTO_NANAMI.title: Nanami
OTTO_NANAMI.description: The Ancient Form threshold is fixed at 100 this combat.
OTTO_LOST_PARADISE_CARD.title: Lost Paradise Arrives
OTTO_LOST_PARADISE_CARD.description: Summon Huo Xing Bao. After each Attack you play, it acts once.
OTTO_CCB.title: CCB
OTTO_CCB.description: Remove all your Weak, Vulnerable, Frail and Poison. Apply twice the removed stacks of each to ALL enemies. Draw 2 cards.
OTTO_AN_NAI.title: Master An Nai
OTTO_AN_NAI.description: Choose up to 2 non-X-cost cards in your draw pile. Upgrade them and put them into your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
OTTO_DA_SI_MA_CARD.title: Wuhu Da Si Ma
OTTO_DA_SI_MA_CARD.description: After drawing next turn, replay this turn's last manually played non-X Attack or Skill once for free.
OTTO_JI_BAI.title: Ji Bai!
OTTO_JI_BAI.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Repeat once for each remaining round of Ancient Form, then exit the form.
OTTO_SOYO.title: Nagasaki Soyo-official
OTTO_SOYO.description: Exhaust any number of other cards in your hand. For each card Exhausted, gain {Block:diff()} Block and draw 1 card.
OTTO_TOMORI.title: Takamatsu Tomori-official
OTTO_TOMORI.description: Return up to {Cards:diff()} cards from your Discard pile to your hand. Gain 1 Energy for each Girl Band card chosen.
OTTO_V5.title: v5-otto
OTTO_V5.description: At the end of your turn, auto-play 3 random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}Block cards from all character pools for free. Duplicates allowed.
OTTO_TOMORI.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to return from your Discard pile.
